definitions.explanation: Amateur carpentry or home improvement work done as a hobby, typically on weekends.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{日曜大工|にちようだいく}で{本棚|ほんだな}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: My father made a bookshelf as a DIY project.

examples.japanese: {日曜大工|にちようだいく}が{趣味|しゅみ}です。
{日曜大工|にちようだいく}で{棚|たな}の{修理|しゅうり}をした。
examples.english: I fixed the shelf myself as a DIY project.

examples.japanese: {日曜大工|にちようだいく}の{道具|どうぐ}をホームセンターで{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought DIY tools at the home improvement store.

examples.japanese: {休|やす}みの{日|ひ}に{日曜大工|にちようだいく}で{犬小屋|いぬごや}を{作|つく}ることにした。
examples.english: I decided to build a doghouse as a DIY project on my day off.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{日曜|にちよう} (Sunday) + {大工|だいく} (carpenter). The term refers to amateur carpentry done on weekends/days off.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{日曜大工|にちようだいく}をする (to do DIY)
・{日曜大工|にちようだいく}で{作|つく}る (to make [something] as DIY)
・{日曜大工|にちようだいく}{用品|ようひん} (DIY supplies)

MODERN USAGE:
While {日曜大工|にちようだいく} traditionally meant carpentry, the English "DIY" is now also commonly used in Japanese (ディーアイワイ) for general home improvement.

RELATED TERMS:
・ホームセンター (home improvement store)
・{工具|こうぐ} (tools)
・DIY (ディーアイワイ)
